## Web search results

Set one query in Search Query. Configure Tavily Search HTTP Header Auth with Authorization: Bearer <your Tavily API key>. Tavily basic/general search requests up to5 results and disables generated answers, raw page content, images and automatic parameter selection. Format Results returns title/url/snippet items in provider order. No LLM or additional page crawl is included. See README.

## Source backend change

The source used Superhighway. Its official endpoint now reports shutdown on2026-10-26. This adaptation uses Tavily in both formats. Results, snippets, ranking and API allowance differ. An empty results array is a successful zero-match result; malformed or failed responses stop without a false success. Keep API keys in credentials.

name: Live Web Research Agent with Superhighway
